architectureClaims: Capital owns financial semantics; shared Composition owns generic task-local composition mechanics.
Shared Composition authority-obligation binding never grants financial/provider/execution authority.
Financial effect ordering remains Capital-owned: Reserve before Effect, Reconcile and Account after admitted effect.
Read-only and non-live circuit execution remains owner-native and mechanically compatible with R1 external receipts.
Current State is generated from machine authorities and does not use Git recency as semantic currentness.
Capital-to-Composition is an explicit public-package dependency and therefore a real verification-graph edge.
nonClaims: R2 does not admit production financial writes.
R2 does not admit private account data.
R2 does not infer owner risk appetite.
R2 does not add a general autonomous investment decision engine.
R2 does not make mechanical circuit closure a financial/domain verdict.
R2 does not make local accounting settlement or provider truth.
